title: Who will win the 2026 Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District?
background: Andy Ogles has represented Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives since 2023.
resolution_criteria:
Source of Truth : Official Tennessee election results, with a definitive Associated Press race call accepted before certification. 
  Resolution Event : The determination of the winner of the Republican primary for Tennessee’s 5th Congressional District scheduled for August 6, 2026. 
  Accepted Answer Format : The winning candidate’s full name.
